cards.example_en: We visited a historic castle during the weekend trip.
cards.example_zh: 周末出游时，我们参观了一座有历史意义的城堡。

cards.example_en: After school we play hockey on the field behind the gym.
cards.example_zh: 放学后，我们在体育馆后面的场地上打曲棍球。

cards.example_en: With a short speech, the students paid homage to the old scientist.
cards.example_zh: 学生们发表简短讲话，向那位老科学家致敬。

cards.example_en: Hooray, our class won the city basketball match this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 好哇，我们班今天下午赢了全市篮球赛。

cards.example_en: When the bell rings, the children hop across the playground together.
cards.example_zh: 铃一响，孩子们就一起单脚跳着穿过操场。

cards.example_en: There was a horrible noise outside.
cards.example_zh: 外面有可怕的响声。

cards.example_en: Dad bought me a hotdog and a cold drink at the stadium.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸在体育场给我买了一个热狗和一杯冷饮。

cards.example_en: After heavy rain, the air felt humid all over the city.
cards.example_zh: 大雨过后，全城的空气都感觉很潮湿。

cards.example_en: He told a humorous story.
cards.example_zh: 他讲了一个幽默的故事。

cards.example_en: In the story, a family builds an igloo from blocks of snow.
cards.example_zh: 故事里，一家人用雪块搭了一座冰屋。

cards.example_en: Don't ignore the warning signs.
cards.example_zh: 不要忽视雾警标志。

cards.example_en: Parking on the pavement is illegal in our city.
cards.example_zh: 在我们这座城市，把车停在人行道上是非法的。

cards.example_en: Please come immediately.
cards.example_zh: 请立刻过来。

cards.example_en: The museum left a deep impression on my little sister.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆给我妹妹留下了深刻的印象。

cards.example_en: Her painting of the lake was impressive at the show.
cards.example_zh: 她画的那幅湖景在展览上令人印象深刻。

cards.example_en: The hero is an incarnation of courage in that old adventure film.
cards.example_zh: 在那部老冒险片里，主人公是勇气的化身。

cards.example_en: The puddle grew an inch deeper after the noon storm.
cards.example_zh: 中午的暴风雨过后，水坑又深了一英寸。

cards.example_en: Menus improve with the inclusion of fresh fruit at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午餐菜单因为纳入新鲜水果而变得更好。

cards.example_en: Sorry for the inconvenience, but the lift is closed for repair.
cards.example_zh: 电梯正在维修，给您带来不便，非常抱歉。

cards.example_en: She became more independent at university.
cards.example_zh: 她在大学里变得更加独立。

cards.example_en: Sugar is the main ingredient in this homemade strawberry cake.
cards.example_zh: 糖是这块自制草莓蛋糕的主要原料。

cards.example_en: My initial reaction was surprise.
cards.example_zh: 我最初的反应是惊讶。

cards.example_en: She took the initiative and booked the room for our meeting.
cards.example_zh: 她采取主动行动，为我们的会议订好了房间。

cards.example_en: Be careful, or you may injure your knee on the icy road.
cards.example_zh: 小心，不然你可能会在结冰的路上伤到膝盖。

cards.example_en: Blue ink spilled across my notebook during the art lesson.
cards.example_zh: 美术课上，蓝墨水洒在了我的笔记本上。

cards.example_en: We stayed at a quiet inn beside the lake last weekend.
cards.example_zh: 上周末，我们住在湖边一家安静的小旅馆里。

cards.example_en: Before the school trip, an inspector checked every bus carefully.
cards.example_zh: 学校旅行开始前，一位检查员仔细检查了每一辆公共汽车。

cards.example_en: Please instruct the new players before the football match starts.
cards.example_zh: 足球比赛开始前，请指导一下新队员。

cards.example_en: Please don't interrupt the speaker.
cards.example_zh: 请不要打断发言的人。

cards.example_en: The telephone was a great invention.
cards.example_zh: 电话是一项伟大的发明。

cards.example_en: In daylight, the tiny crack in the glass was almost invisible.
cards.example_zh: 在日光下，玻璃上的那道细裂纹几乎看不见。

cards.example_en: I received an invitation to my cousin's birthday party on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 我收到了星期天参加表哥生日聚会的请柬。

cards.example_en: Please italicize the book title when you type the reading list.
cards.example_zh: 录入阅读书单时，请把书名排成斜体。

cards.example_en: One item on the list was sold out by noon.
cards.example_zh: 清单上有一项到中午就卖光了。

cards.example_en: She spread jam on the toast.
cards.example_zh: 她在吐司上抹了果酱。

cards.example_en: Jam filled the jar that Grandma sealed last summer.
cards.example_zh: 果酱装满了奶奶去年夏天封好的广口瓶。

cards.example_en: He rubbed his sore jaw.
cards.example_zh: 他揉了揉酸痛的下巴。

cards.example_en: Tom felt jealous when his brother got a new bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 弟弟得到一辆新自行车时，汤姆感到很嫉妒。

cards.example_en: Can you juggle three apples without dropping them on the floor?
cards.example_zh: 你能抛接三个苹果，还不让它们掉到地上吗？

cards.example_en: Rare birds live in the jungle.
cards.example_zh: 珍稀鸟类生活在丛林里。

cards.example_en: A kangaroo jumped across the road.
cards.example_zh: 一只袋鼠跳过了马路。

cards.example_en: Lucy is keen on swimming and goes to the pool every morning.
cards.example_zh: 露西热衷于游泳，每天早上去游泳池。

cards.example_en: Near the park, police stopped a man who tried to kidnap the child.
cards.example_zh: 在公园附近，警察拦住了一个企图绑架那个孩子的男子。

cards.example_en: Last night police caught the kidnapper near the railway station.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚警察在火车站附近抓住了绑架者。

cards.example_en: Dad used a repair kit from the boot to fix the flat tyre.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸用后备箱里的成套工具修好了瘪胎。

cards.example_en: Players kneel on the grass when they tie their football boots.
cards.example_zh: 球员系足球鞋带时跪在草地上。

cards.example_en: Check the label on the bottle before you take any medicine.
cards.example_zh: 吃药之前，先看一看瓶子上的标签。

cards.example_en: We heated the liquid in the laboratory during chemistry class.
cards.example_zh: 化学课上，我们在实验室里加热了那种液体。

cards.example_en: Farm labour starts early when the rice is ready to cut.
cards.example_zh: 稻子可以收割时，田间劳动一大早就开始了。

cards.example_en: The lamb stayed close to its mother.
cards.example_zh: 羊羔紧紧跟着母亲。
